title: 5,000 Days Running Crisp: The Math Nobody Talks About

slides.headline: 5,000 Days. One Marketing Agency.
slides.subtext: The brutal lessons nobody tells you.
slides.visual_note: Dark background, white bold text, subtle calendar icon showing '5,000' in large numerals

slides.headline: Lesson 1: Survival Is About Speed
slides.body:
Day 1,247: Lost a $180K/year client on Monday.
Signed a $220K client by Friday.

Why we survived:
• 48-hour response time on all inbound
• No 'let me check with my team'
• Proposals sent same day
slides.visual_note: Speedometer graphic or clock icon, emphasize '48 hours' in accent color

slides.headline: Lesson 2: Fire 20% Every Year
slides.body:
Not clients. Systems.

• 73 tools tested since 2010
• Currently use 11
• Killed: Hubspot, Marketo, 4 CRMs

The bloat will kill you before the competition does.
slides.visual_note: Visual of tools/apps being crossed out, funnel narrowing from 73 to 11

slides.headline: Lesson 3: Track Revenue Per Hour
slides.body:
We fired a $15K/month client.

The math:
• 47 hours/month managing them
• $319/hour effective rate

Our target: $500/hour

Time is inventory. You can't make more of it.
slides.visual_note: Calculator or spreadsheet aesthetic, highlight the hourly rate comparison

slides.headline: Lesson 4: The 'Expert' Trap
slides.body:
Year 3: Tried to be experts at everything.
Result: Mediocre at 9 things.

Year 8: Picked one vertical. Law firms.
Result: 3x revenue. Half the stress.

Specialization isn't limiting. It's profitable.
slides.visual_note: Before/after visual — scattered services vs. focused target icon

slides.headline: Lesson 5: Pricing Is a Filter
slides.body:
Raised prices 40% in 2019.

• Lost 8 clients
• Signed 12 new ones
• Cut 160 hours/month of pain

Low prices attract clients who blame you when THEIR business fails.
slides.visual_note: Filter/funnel graphic showing quality clients vs. problem clients

slides.headline: The One Thing That Never Changed
slides.body:
We answer the phone.

Day 1 to Day 5,000:
• Calls forwarded to my cell
• Under 2-ring pickup average
• No 'leave a message' in business hours

Speed to lead isn't a tactic. It's the business.
slides.visual_note: Phone icon with '2 rings' prominently displayed, stopwatch element

slides.headline: Your Turn
slides.body:
5,000 days = 13.7 years.

We've audited 200+ law firm marketing systems.

The firms that grow: fast intake, lean tech stack, specialized positioning.

Comment 'AUDIT' for a free 15-min breakdown of your current setup.
